header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Sandeep Kumar Maheshwari advocate for the
body: Through instant Petition, the petitioner has prayed that respondents be directed to release the amount in respect of Group Insurance to the petitioner. Notices were issued to the respondents; whereupon respondent No.2 has filed his comments wherein he submits that case of the petitioner was forwarded to the respondents No.3 and 4 for further process; however, yet not been completed by them. In view of such a situation, respondents No.3 and 4 are directed to complete the process for releasing the Group Insurance to the petitioner within 30 days and submit compliance report to this Court through learned Additional Registrar.
In view of above, instant petition stands disposed of. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
